Population increased in Wealden

The estimated population of Wealden in 2024 was 166,908 usual residents, a rise of 1.2% since 2023.

This meant that Wealden's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Wealden increased by 3.9%.

Over this slightly longer period, Wealden was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Wealden

The average (median) age fell to 49.5 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Wealden has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Wealden is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Wealden's population of 166,908 usual residents was made up of:

  • 27,605 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.5%)
  • 93,959 people aged 16 to 64 years, (56.3%)
  • 45,344 people aged 65 years and over, (27.2%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Wealden has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (27.2% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Wealden, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Wealden
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Wealden, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 483 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 1,337 births and 1,820 deaths in Wealden.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,999 (1.2%). There were 10,130 people entering the area and 8,131 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Wealden's population of 528 (0.3%) as a result of 920 people entering the area and 392 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Wealden was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Wealden in mid-2023 is 164,861.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 259 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 51 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 208 people.
